Indicates whether the trip met on-time performance standards based on schedule adherence thresholds.
Estimated or allocated operating cost for this trip, including labor, fuel, and maintenance.
Total number of passengers who boarded during this trip, as recorded by automatic passenger counters or manual counts.
Indicates whether this trip operates during peak commute hours (true) or off-peak hours (false).
reference: FTA Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual

description: Indicates whether real-time passenger information was available and published for this trip.
Hours the vehicle was in revenue service (available to passengers) during this trip.
Miles traveled while the vehicle is in revenue service (available to passengers) during this trip.
Planned duration of the trip in minutes from first stop departure to last stop arrival.
Planned arrival time at the final stop of the trip according to the published schedule.
Planned departure time from the first stop of the trip according to the published schedule.
Number of seated passenger positions available on the vehicle for this trip.
reference: FTA Transit Capacity and Quality of Service Manual

description: Classification of the geographic service area in which this trip operates.
Operating date for which this trip is scheduled, following transit day convention (service day may extend past midnight).
Public-facing short identifier for the trip, used in schedules and passenger information.
Current operational status of the trip indicating whether it is scheduled, active, completed, or disrupted.
General traffic conditions encountered during the trip that may have affected schedule adherence.
Name of the transit agency or operator providing this trip service.
Classification of the trip service type indicating stop pattern and service characteristics.
Total passenger capacity of the vehicle assigned to this trip, including seated and standing capacity.

Primary key for zone
Current compliance status with ADA accessibility requirements for transit services within the zone. Critical for federal funding eligibility.
Textual description of the geographic boundaries defining the zone. Includes major roads, natural features, or jurisdictional limits used as boundaries.
Short alphanumeric code used to identify the transit zone in operational systems and reporting. Used for quick reference and system integration.
Special coordination requirements or agreements with adjacent zones, regional authorities, or state agencies. Documents inter-jurisdictional service arrangements.
Comma-separated list of North Carolina counties included within the transit zone boundaries. Used for jurisdictional coordination and reporting.
Date when the zone definition became or will become active for service planning and funding allocation purposes.
Date when the zone definition is scheduled to expire or be reviewed. Null indicates no planned expiration.
Pricing model used for transit services within the zone. Impacts revenue forecasting and equity analysis.
Primary FTA grant program(s) for which this zone qualifies. Determines available federal funding sources for transit services.
Name of the MPO or RPO responsible for transportation planning coordination within this zone. Critical for grant coordination and regional planning alignment.
Full descriptive name of the transit zone, used for display and reporting purposes.
Additional operational notes, special considerations, or historical context relevant to the zone definition and management.
Total population residing within the transit zone boundaries. Used for service demand forecasting and funding formula calculations.
Average number of residents per square mile within the zone. Key metric for determining service type and frequency requirements.
Name of the primary transit agency or operator providing service within this zone. May be a public transit authority, county government, or contracted operator.
Total geographic area covered by the transit zone measured in square miles. Used for service planning and resource allocation.
Primary type of transit service operating within the zone. Determines operational requirements and performance metrics.
Current operational status of the transit zone. Active zones are eligible for service and funding allocation.
Classification of the transit zone based on geographic and demographic characteristics. Determines applicable funding programs and service requirements.
